units.source_text: 男人歪着嘴，粗暴地打断，

en.t: The man twisted his mouth and cut in harshly,

units.source_text: 仿佛自己心中沙子的印象，被无知亵渎了一样，

en.t: as if the image of sand he held in his mind had been profaned by ignorance,

units.source_text: “我呀，对沙子还是小有研究，比较清楚的……

en.t: "As for me, I have studied sand a little, so I know it fairly well...

units.source_text: 怎么样，沙子这东西呀，一年四季都流动不停呀……

en.t: You see, sand is something that keeps flowing all year round...

units.source_text: 这个，流动的特点才是沙子的生命呀……

en.t: That quality of flowing is the very life of sand...

units.source_text: 说什么会在一个地方停住，那不可能……

en.t: To say it could stop in one place is impossible...

units.source_text: 就是在水里，在空气里，它都是自由自在活动着的……

en.t: Even in water, even in the air, it moves about freely...

units.source_text: 所以，普通的生物在沙子里扎不了根，也就活不下去哟……

en.t: That is why ordinary living things cannot take root in sand and cannot survive there...
Even putrefying bacteria are the same...

units.source_text: 是呵，话说回来，沙子像是清洁的代名词哟，

en.t: Yes, and to return to the point, sand is practically a synonym for cleanliness,

units.source_text: 所以它该有防腐的作用，

en.t: so it ought to have a preservative effect,

units.source_text: 说什么被沙子腐烂掉了，真是岂有此理……

en.t: to say something rotted away because of sand is simply absurd...

units.source_text: 更何况，太太，您还说沙子本身也会烂……

en.t: Besides, madam, you even say that sand itself can rot...

units.source_text: 首先，沙子那东西呀，明摆着是矿物质嘛。”

en.t: To begin with, sand is obviously a mineral, after all."
